scope: Host-only review of existing exact native-positive short HF controls, commands, pinned runner, and grouped cost forecast. No model load, network access, device work, or proposal edits.

case_selection.result: All three selected exact saved suffix512 fixtures and matching full-TT outputs/hashes verified. Fixtures have 512 prompt IDs, the same exact source prompt suffix, chosen64 IDs, sampling 1.0/0.95/20, pinned revision 842da3794eaa0b77d5f08bae87a17459d91ff475, and recorded seed metadata. Matched full-TT outputs contain 512 tokens of only caret characters at positive seeds 42,42,44 respectively.
case_selection.scope_limit: Positive means the exact short full-TT diagnostic reproduces the caret motif; it does not claim native prompt identity or incidence.

commands_and_runner.offline: Both actual group commands set HF_HUB_OFFLINE=1 and HF_DATASETS_OFFLINE=1; runner uses local_files_only=True for tokenizer and the revision is pinned in reference/weights code; offline environment also covers config, generation config, and hub weights.
commands_and_runner.cpu_threads: load_reference() calls torch.set_num_threads(16) before loading the reference model.
commands_and_runner.serial: Seed42 group (2 cases) and seed44 group (1 case) are ordered 1 then 2, each in its own process, with explicit serial-execution instruction and one model load per group. Each command timeout is3600s.
commands_and_runner.comparison: Repeated --compare-dir is supported by runner argparse; output job names align to both existing served/full short-control JSON filenames and chosen64 forced IDs are checked.

cost_review.source_hashes_and_cumulative_deltas: All 8 listed HF source-result hashes, cumulative totals, and incremental differences verified. Each source is complete, prompt512, chosen TF64, and one generated512-token result.
cost_review.formula: Median matched incremental HF case wall × cases per process +180s model/process margin per seed group; range uses 800–1600s per case plus one180s margin per process.
cost_review.check: Stored medians, group points/ranges, and totals recompute. Both group upper bounds fit their individual 3600s timeout.
cost_review.limits: Point/range are host wall planning estimates from different prompt contents and may vary; no serving/performance claim.

prelaunch_gates.satisfied_in_proposal: A no-prior-HF-process check is stated in plan.json; groups are serial.
missing_or_understated: No explicit MemAvailable >=100GB threshold appears in the plan, command gate, or preparation artifacts; plan only says to check available memory.
commands.json gate waits for adaptive suffix1024 completion and root review but does not explicitly require all TT diagnostic queues complete or zero active TT owners before these HF processes.
prelaunch_gates.live_evidence: No fresh MemAvailable or process snapshot is present. This is expected for an unlaunched candidate; those checks must be recorded at the eventual launch gate.
prelaunch_gates.disposition: Substantive prelaunch documentation gaps: before execution, make the >=100GB check and all-TT-queues-drained condition explicit and record fresh memory/process evidence. No launch performed.

findings: Prelaunch gate is incomplete: explicit MemAvailable>=100GB and all TT queues complete/zero owners are not stated.
not_findings: Pinned/offline HF invocation, serial grouping, CPU16 thread setting, source fixture integrity, and grouped cost arithmetic are valid.
limitations: Proposal still depends on later adaptive-suffix1024 completion and root review for any added cases.
